title: Postharvest Defects, Mold Risk & Deviation Investigation
description: Develops evidence-based defect description, fungal-risk interpretation, sanitary inspection and containment, deviation investigation, CAPA and disposition escalation while preserving diagnostic uncertainty.
learningOutcomes: Classify postharvest observations as direct evidence, pattern, contextual evidence or unconfirmed causal interpretation.
Analyze fungal-risk conditions and explain why visual, odor and environmental clues require qualified confirmation and product-specific evaluation.
Design a sanitary inspection and sampling workflow that maps affected scope without spreading material or losing identity.
Evaluate a postharvest deviation using timeline, scope, causal evidence, root-cause uncertainty and corrective/preventive action.
Apply hold and escalation controls while distinguishing evidence collection from authorized release, rework, rejection or destruction decisions.
